description: Asks how + and & dispatch over numeric 7, text "7", nonnumeric text, Null and (through an undeclared parameter) Empty, and the result tag of each. Each literal expression and each stored-field expression on Vals is its own SELECT. [pe] + 7, [pe] & 'x' and [pe] + [pe] are each run with Empty and with Null. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
